summary: Immuron Ltd furnished a Form 6-K reporting an announcement to the ASX regarding an exclusive distribution agreement with Calmino group AB for PROIBS in the United States. This is a routine commercial distribution arrangement, not a special situation. The filing includes no deal terms beyond the exclusive distribution scope. Immuron already launched PROIBS in Australia during FY26. The agreement expands an existing partnership. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural details were disclosed. Market data cited includes $4.16 billion digestive health supplement market. The agreement represents ordinary business development with no risk-arb or special-situation angle; investors should monitor sales execution and partnership expansion.
